steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies first — the platinum has no task of its own.
Follow the 8 stops in order so nothing is left to chance at the end.
Check A Long Road (100%) before the final cleanup, then watch the platinum pop.
Start the story and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends — it is mandatory, so it cannot be missed.
Use this early stretch to learn the controls and scan vehicles as you go.
Play every story mission in Chapter 1 through to the chapter finale.
Before leaving Chapter 1, meditate at the early Chapter 1 spot — it is gone for good after the chapter closes.
Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 2: there is no mission replay and no New Game+.
Play through Chapter 2, once Jason and Lucia are both playable.
Finish the chapter's story missions and the trophy pops at the chapter's end.
Take side content as it appears in Chapter 2 instead of leaving it all for post-story cleanup.
Play through Chapter 3's story missions to the chapter's end.
Do stranger missions the moment they appear in Chapter 3 — the race against Yago strand is time-sensitive.
Watch for robbery trophies opening in Chapter 3: bank vaults and armored trucks.
Play through Chapter 4's story missions to the chapter's end.
Before the final mission, make a manual save — it is your only way back to anything story-gated.
After the credits, free roam stays open and almost everything else can still be finished.
Finish the final mission after Chapter 4 and watch the credits.
Before starting it, check the Missables tab: the Chapter 1 meditation spot and the time-sensitive stranger strand must already be done.
Once the credits roll, free roam opens and the cleanup stops begin.
Play the story until the mission Breakfast Run appears.
Complete the mission — the trophy pops when it ends.
No source reports this mission as optional or branching, so it cannot be missed.
Play the story until the mission The Cartel Heist appears.
Complete the heist mission — the trophy pops when it ends.
Treat heist missions as practice for the freeroam robbery trophies that open later.
Play the story until the mission Child's Play appears.
Complete the mission — the trophy pops when it ends.
This is one of the twelve story trophies hidden on PSN until earned.
Play the story until the mission Headliners appears.
Complete the mission — the trophy pops when it ends.
Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter anyway: with no mission replay, a chapter-start save is the only way back.
Play the story until the mission VCIA Takedown appears, around the airport.
Complete the mission — the trophy pops when it ends.
Remember the airport layout: it matters again later for the unscheduled departure trophy.
Play the story until the mission Operation Savage Glory appears.
Complete the mission — the trophy pops when it ends.
By this point the Chapter 1 meditation spot should already be banked — if not, and you are past Chapter 1, only a chapter-start save can save the run.
Open the 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) once it becomes visible after the story.
Do optional missions when they appear — they close mid-story and feed the checklist.

Aim for the forgiving thresholds (about 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges) while completing robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests in full.
Find a jump or ramp with a clean landing zone and repeat it in free roam after the story.
Land 250 stunts — air time and a clean landing both count toward the total.
Keep going to 300 stunts if you are chasing A Long Road, which wants more than the trophy does.
Try each of the 9 activity types once — one taste of everything is enough.
Work through the activity trophies on this list (ranges, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, bowling) and this fills itself in.
Tick each type off in the counter so you can see which one is still missing.
Visit the Shooting Ranges across Leonida — 42 challenges in total.
Earn a gold medal in each challenge, one at a time rather than in a single sitting.
Ranges must also be fully complete for the 100% checklist, so there is no shortcut around them.
Find the Top Fun Drone Race locations — 14 of them across Leonida.
Learn each course's line before racing it for the win — a practice lap beats three rushed attempts.
Drone races must also be fully complete for the 100% checklist.
Pick a fast, stable car and learn the braking points.
Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so variety matters more than repeating a favourite.
Work through the race list region by region.
Take Cal's fishing challenge when it appears.
Watch the line tension, reel steadily, and do not rush the catch.
Beat Cal and the trophy pops.
Find an arcade machine in Vice City.
Pick the game you find easiest and play it through to completion.
Finishing one run is enough — no leaderboard score is needed.
Take Andy's missions whenever they appear.
Follow the strand through to its final mission.
Complete the final mission for Andy and the trophy pops.
Take Kenton's missions whenever they appear.
Follow the strand through to its final mission.
Complete the final mission for Kenton and the trophy pops.
Take Billy's missions whenever they appear.
Follow the strand through to its final mission — it runs through the Mount Kalaga area.
Complete the final mission for Billy and the trophy pops.
Start every stranger strand the moment its icon appears on the map.
In Chapter 3, do the race against Yago strand at once — it closes mid-story.
Complete 8 stranger strands in total and the silver pops.
Take Randy's missions whenever they appear.
Follow the strand through to its final mission.
Complete the final mission for Randy and the trophy pops.
Take Tyrone's missions whenever they appear.
Follow the strand through to its final mission — it runs through the Ambrosia area.
Complete the final mission for Tyrone and the trophy pops.
In Chapter 1, meditate at the early spot the moment you see it — it disappears permanently once the chapter closes.
After Chapter 1, meditate at every spot you pass in each region; never walk past one.
Track your count with the stepper below and check it reads 18/18 before the cleanup stop.

versions.label: Version A — 18 spots (PSN target 0/18; PowerPyx, OutputLag, eGamers, KeenGamer)
versions.text: There are 18 meditation spots in 10 locations across Leonida, and the PSN counter runs to 18. The early Chapter 1 spot is required — and missable.

versions.label: Version B — 15 spots (some launch guides count 15)
versions.text: Some launch guides count only 15 meditation spots. The total is disputed.

versions.label: The Chapter 1 spot — two descriptions, one warning
versions.text: PowerPyx places the Chapter 1 spot at Jason's house. OutputLag and eGamers describe a balcony meditation early in Chapter 1. They may be the same spot described differently — either way, meditate at every spot you see in Chapter 1. Safe play: track to 18, the higher count and the PSN target.

steps.t: Take Bret's hunt when he offers it.
Track the unique animal and take the shot cleanly.
Bret's quests must be fully complete for the 100% checklist, so this is part of the A Long Road work.
Search for collectible cards across Leonida, region by region.
Clear one region's cards before moving to the next.
Complete 3 full card sets and the silver pops.
Use WAiNK It at a new location — every distinct spot counts once.
Sweep the map region by region instead of repeating the same spots.
Pair it with exploring all 52 areas: visiting new ground moves both counters.
Pick the easy challenges first — you only need 50 of them.
Skip the hardest ones: the 100% checklist itself only needs 70 of 80.
Work them in the grind stop, when you can cherry-pick by region.
With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level.
Pick open ground with escape routes — countryside roads beat downtown dead-ends.
Break line of sight together and lose the cops with your partner.
Find three shops close together and plan the route between them first.
With your partner, rob the first shop, then move fast to the second and third.
Stay wanted the whole time — do not hide or wait the heat out between robberies.
From the first hour, get into — or scan — every new vehicle you pass.
Do not always take the same car: variety is what moves the counter.
Tour regions you have not driven through yet for the rare, region-specific vehicles.
Find a fight with at least 5 enemies close together.
Wait until five are in range, then trigger Combat Focus.
Chain the five takedowns without wasting time between them; if it fails, retry the same spot.
Head to VCIA, the Vice City airport — you will know the layout from the story mission.
Get to a plane on the airfield.
Take off on your own terms, without a schedule, and the trophy pops.
Stir up enough heat to draw a Rhino tank out, or look around military presence.
Get behind the wheel of the Rhino.
Grab this one early in the crime stop — a stolen tank makes the other crime trophies easier.
Pick a jewelry store in Vice City and approach it quietly.
Watch the sightlines, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
If you are spotted, the attempt is done — leave, let the heat cool, and come back for a clean run.
Plan the approach to a bank vault, then hit it.
Escape after each vault — a vault only counts if you get away clean.
Repeat for 5 vaults; robberies must be fully complete for the 100% checklist too.
Watch the roads for an armored truck on its route.
Stop the truck and take the cash.
Have your getaway car ready before you start, and escape — one clean hit is all it takes.
Tour the map deliberately instead of fast-travelling past it — the counter moves when you set foot somewhere new.
Pair the tour with the WAiNK and card collections: one sweep of a region can move three counters at once.
Save a dedicated tour for the remote areas at the end (Mount Kalaga, the Keys).
Learn which illegal operation belongs to which gang — every gang counts once.
Rob one operation from each of the 9 gangs, ticking them off one by one.
Use the counter to see which gangs are still missing, and work the map region by region.
The trigger is not yet confirmed in public — do not waste hours guessing.
What is known: a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, and a name that suggests an early-game moment — try it as early as you can.
Check the sources below again after the launch guides update.
The trigger is not yet confirmed in public — do not waste hours guessing.
What is known: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — which showroom, and what counts, is not confirmed yet.
Try it in the cleanup stop, and watch the sources below for a confirmed trigger.
Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Vice City.
Pick up a ball and bowl a game — follow through on the lane.
One game is enough, and it counts as one of the 9 activity types.
The launch guides do not pin down one exact moment for this trophy.
Play the story with your partner beside you and take the high-profile things you do together.
If it has not popped by the cleanup stop, re-check the cited guides — they are still being updated after launch.
Play normally through the story and the side stops — every small decision counts toward the total.
Engage with the world instead of rushing past it.
Check the counter in the grind stop and top it up with whatever choices are left.
The trigger is not yet confirmed in public — do not waste hours guessing.
What is known: 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt — but what, and where, is not confirmed.
Leave it for the cleanup stop and check the sources below for a confirmed trigger.
The trigger is not yet confirmed in public — do not waste hours guessing.
What is known: 'What the hell just happened?' points to a strange, unexplained event — which event, and where, is not confirmed.
Leave it for the cleanup stop and check the sources below for a confirmed trigger.
The trigger is not yet confirmed in public — do not waste hours guessing.
What is known: bowl people over with a melee drive-by — strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon — but the exact count and conditions are not confirmed.
The bowling-alley area is the natural place to try it in cleanup, once a source confirms the trigger.
Rob first: Marked Bills come from robberies.
Launder the bills through your contacts in steady batches, not all at once.
Start laundering the moment you have bills to wash instead of stockpiling them for the end.
Buy what you actually use — weapons, ammo, clothes, car upgrades — and the total climbs without waste.
Every purchase across all shops counts toward the $100,000 total.
Do it in the grind stop, when robbery and laundering money is there to spend.
Earn the cash first — robberies and laundering pay for the garages.
Buy the 8 garage properties one by one, as you go.
Each garage stores the vehicles you discover, so buying early helps the vehicle counter too.
Find vehicles out in the world — the ones you discover for the vehicle counter are natural candidates.
Register each one through the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 vehicles in total, in the grind stop while you tour the regions.
